svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, two inputs, two hot-swap supplies (nominal 12 V, 12.5 A)
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V ~2.5 A MAX, 50/60 Hz (printed beside the inlets, partly hidden)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: brochure: the 25 Gigabit ports are backward compatible with 10 Gigabit and 1 Gigabit SFP devices
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: brochure: two 100 Gigabit QSFP28 ports; the photograph prints 40G/100G under them; no module is included
